acquire_run.purpose: Take the transform lock for the run, make the run folder and copy the fixture seed into it

catalog_up.purpose: Start the catalog and register the run as a catalog user

fixture.reason: the fixture mode reads a fixture bronze database, so no catalog starts and no catalog user is registered

pin_bronze.purpose: Record the snapshot ID of every bronze table the build reads

fixture.reason: the fixture mode has no bronze to pin or verify, so the step records why it did nothing

silver_build.purpose: Build the kept silver models into the run's build file at the pinned bronze snapshots

silver_validate.purpose: Run the atomic silver Great Expectations contracts on the build file and record its SHA-256 and the run

gold_build.purpose: Build the gold dimensions, bridges and facts on the same build file after rechecking its SHA-256

gold_validate.purpose: Run the gold Great Expectations suites

cross_layer_checks.purpose: Reconcile every gold fact with its silver model row for row and by content, and run the silver and gold suites on the same build file

verify_bronze.purpose: Check that the bronze heads still equal the pinned snapshots before any publish

fixture.reason: the fixture mode has no bronze to pin or verify, so the step records why it did nothing

publish_branch.purpose: Record the branch by mode: publish modes continue to publishing and the fixture mode goes to skip_publish

fixture.reason: the branch is the DAG's decision by mode; the step records which path the run takes

skip_publish.purpose: Record why steps 10 to 13 are skipped in the fixture mode

fixture.reason: the fixture mode publishes nothing, so steps 10 to 13 are skipped by the branch

publish_candidates.purpose: Write each gold table with MERGE INTO and record the new snapshot IDs as candidates

reconcile_candidates.purpose: Compare counts and fingerprints of exactly the candidate snapshots with the build

catalog_backup.purpose: Write the catalog backup and read it back

commit_publish.purpose: Write the publish_runs row naming the candidate snapshot set, last

run_record.purpose: Write the durable run record and move the run to finalizing; the build file and the lock are kept

catalog_release.purpose: Deregister the run as a catalog user and stop the catalog when no user remains

fixture.reason: the fixture mode registered no catalog user, so nothing is deregistered

final_gate_accepted.purpose: Write the accepted result of the final gate and the DAG run's predecessor states into the run record

final_gate_rejected.purpose: Write the rejected result of the final gate and the DAG run's predecessor states into the run record

release_accepted.purpose: After an accepted gate, stop what is open, delete the build files and release the lock

release_rejected.purpose: After a rejected gate, stop what is open, keep the build files and keep the lock as failed_retained

gold_maintenance.purpose: Expire gold snapshots and compact files, keeping every registered or reserved snapshot set (gold_maintenance_dag)

sense_markers.purpose: Read the approved bronze snapshot manifest and the gold publish_runs head for sensing_dag

real.reason: no launcher template runs this step yet; the launcher gains a row for it with the DAG package that needs it
